Milestone 1 Proof of Achievement:

Website: https://identusbook.com
Table of Contents with chapter descriptions: https://identusbook.com/book
Open Source Example App Idea:
 Educational Credentials:
 The example application will demonstrate for developers how to issue educational credentials to digital identity wallet holders.
 - Users will be able to indicate they completed a course and be issued a Verifiable Credential.
 - Users will be able to verify the credentials of other users.
 - Users will be able to selectively disclose course completion status without revealing personally identifiable information.
 This example app will show developers all the key ingredients they need to know in order to build complex Self Sovereign Identity applications with Identus (Atala PRISM)
